device_entry.name: PI E-816压电定位控制器
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 用于驱动压电定位平台或压电执行器的精密运动控制器。该设备通过串口进行位置查询与运动控制，支持单通道或XY通道的位置读取、绝对/相对移动、到位状态检查、漂移补偿、行程范围查询和固件版本读取，常用于显微镜纳米定位、对焦或样品精密扫描。
device_entry.description_en: A precision motion controller for driving a piezo positioning stage or piezo actuator. It communicates over a serial interface and supports position readback, absolute and relative moves, XY motion, on-target status checks, drift compensation, travel range queries, and firmware version retrieval. It is commonly used for microscope nanopositioning, focus control, and fine sample scanning.
